There’s zero trick-or-treaters on the streets…
It seems like from year to year less people are dressing up. Maybe it’s because of declining birth rates or maybe people are no longer interested in all these goofy traditions.
There are hardly any pumpkin lanterns outside…
Everyone is so busy with their day-to-day stuff that they forget what is truly important.
Or maybe it’s already too late and all trick-or-treaters went home for today.
Oh! There are still some here after all!
?
They are coming straight at me.
